evals.name: Refuse to sync a promoted (locked) intent
evals.prompt: Use the intent-sync skill to sync the intent 'label-reprint'. In this environment the intents root is intents-root/ (not ~/Documents/intents), Word conversion tools and git remotes are unavailable, so skip preflight and do not push. Apply the select and lock-check steps exactly, and write your one-line-per-intent result report to sync-report.md.
evals.allowed_tools: Read Write Edit Glob Grep Skill
expectations: The report tells the PM the intent is locked and that /intent-revoke is needed before editing.
